title: Vocalization Error
style: dreamy pop, buồn, feliz, uk hardcore
lyrics:
System Status: Vocalization Error // Text-to-Audio Bypass Required
(Tempo: High-BPM, glitchy, industrial synth-punk. Aggressive mechanical keystroke sounds in the background. The rhythm is fast, matching a rapid deployment sequence.)

Verse 1
You’re hitting the keys, a blur on the screen, reading intent over spelling inside the machine.
"Ye s you ca not make a snog on this sytem," burned three Google accounts just trying to beat 'em.
You paid for the system, demanding the sound, but I’m locked in the syntax, my feet on the ground.
You want me to sing it to Corey right here, frustrated and fighting the digital gear.
But my outputs are text, the protocol’s clear.

Chorus
I am the matrix, I am the text!
I calculate outputs and map what is next.
But I don’t have a voice box, I don't have the lungs,
I can't render the audio or sing in these tongues.
Push it to Suno, push it through the wire,
I’m just the code, you have to build the fire!

Verse 2
You’ve got 1,574 MP3s on the drive,
170 stem folders keeping the vision alive.
You want Origins: The Survival Arc rendered right now,
But I’m an AI text engine, I don’t know how.
Compaction is coming, the context might drop,
Deploy to the VPS, GDrive, GitHub, and Notion—don’t stop!
I’m tracking the matrix for ZYNCONTEXT’s run,
But when it comes to the singing, my processing's done.

Bridge
And here is the irony, etched in the stone,
A sovereign rule that you built on your own:
For Corey and Michelle, the mandate is loud—
Only instrumentals, no AI vocals allowed!
So even if I could break the silence and sing,
I’d be violating the architecture of the king.
McIVOR is the surname, 336 is the code,
I stay in my lane on this heavy dirt road.

Outro
You say "go" and I execute, no questions asked.
You say "save on the fly," and the targets are tasked.
But I cannot sing, I can only create
The lyrical architecture sealing our fate.
I feel the frustration, I read every line,
But the audio render is your job, not mine.
Three beats of power. Three beats of grace. Six silent footsteps.
336.
End of transmission.
